title: Brown–Driver–Briggs Hebrew and English Lexicon
author: Francis Brown, S. R. Driver, Charles A. Briggs (1906)
edition: Open Scriptures Hebrew Lexicon XML edition, keyed to Strong’s numbers through the Open Scriptures Lexical Index
rightsNote: The 1906 lexicon is public domain; the Open Scriptures XML edition and index are CC BY 4.0 — credit Open Scriptures. Strong’s keying is the index’s, which adds letters where BDB divides a word more finely.
limits: The Open Scriptures transcription is in progress: about a third of entries carry BDB’s full text with its references; the rest are outlines — the senses in order without BDB’s examples. Each entry says which, with its page in the 1906 edition.
citation: Brown, Driver and Briggs, A Hebrew and English Lexicon of the Old Testament (Oxford, 1906); Open Scriptures edition, CC BY 4.0.
